method: Renders r_w12 (head 08dd180, the w11 fixes) compared with r_w11 by pixel diff, and with omaat_f60, f7, f11, f57 and up_34. Colours are PIL box means, compared as ratios within one image. Flute relief is the p90/p10 of the column-mean luminance across a leaf band. Crops are in scratchpad/qa12a/ (v1_base.png, f60_base.png, v1_leaves.png, q04_duvet_w11_w12.png, v5z.png, v1_seam.png). Code: src/09d_suite.js (360 lines). s4 is pixel-identical to w11; s2, s3, v3 and v4 differ by fewer than 90 px.

calibration.earlier_issue: w11a MED / w11b MED: with the doors closed, a continuous plinth runs under the meeting leaves instead of the dark void in f60
calibration.status: fixed. The per-leaf plinth is gone. Line 262 fixes plinth faces at -L+0.10..zo0 and zo1..-0.08, and line 241 puts a black toe-kick 0.08 back. In v1 the doorway is now L23 against a field of L83 (0.28x), against f60's 18/63 (0.29x). Plinth/field is 57/83 = 0.69, against f60's 43/63 = 0.68. The void spans about 0.63 of the closed-leaf width, against about 0.57 in f60. See qa12a/v1_base.png vs f60_base.png.

calibration.earlier_issue: w11a LOW: the flutes read as pinstripes (groove 23 % of the pitch, relief 1.31 vs 1.98)
calibration.status: fixed in value. Line 249 makes the slats 0.016, so the groove is about 38 % of the pitch. v1 relief p90/p10 is 1.26-1.33, against my re-measure of f60 at 1.20-1.27 (the w11a figure of 1.98 used a wider band, so it was not like for like). The slats are still flat boxes: f60's ribs have a highlight and a shaded flank, the render's have a flat face (qa12a/v1_leaves.png). That is acceptable at this resolution.

calibration.earlier_issue: w11b LOW: stipple moire on the leaves at grazing and distant angles
calibration.status: not fixed. The narrower slats did not cure it. The right unit's leaf in v5 (qa12a/v5z.png) and the far leaves in q02 (x 840-910) still read as a dotted mesh.

calibration.earlier_issue: w11a/b LOW: the console module has hard flat triangular end faces
calibration.status: not fixed. Line 173 is unchanged and s4 is pixel-identical to w11. The doorstop wedge ends still show at s4 x 520-545 and v2 x 135-240.

calibration.earlier_issue: w11a LOW / w11b LOW: the turned-down duvet corner reads as a flat decal, with no fold edge
calibration.status: partly fixed, with a new artefact. Line 308 makes the triangle 0.014 thick in #c4c0b8, and line 309 adds a ridge. Under cabin light, though, the triangle is L217 against the duvet's L218 (no tonal step). The ridge renders as a thin bright rod, a ruled line. The extrusion's lit side faces outline the two legs, so it still reads as a pasted label (qa12a/q04_duvet_w11_w12.png).

calibration.earlier_issue: w11a LOW: the aisle drape stops 0.06 short and the duvet head end is a cliff
calibration.status: drape fixed: line 310 uses length dl, and the notch is gone. The head end is not fixed: line 304 still uses edge 0.04 with r 0.05, so the head end is a uniform rounded step.

calibration.earlier_issue: w11a LOW: the chrome foot strip is barely legible
calibration.status: fixed. Lines 253 and 267 make it 0.015. In v1, trim/field is 179/83 = 2.16, against f60's 126/63 = 2.0.

calibration.earlier_issue: w11b LOW: plinth too light; far LOD has no plinth
calibration.status: fixed. Line 240 sets #33312b, and line 354 gives the far LOD plinth faces.

calibration.earlier_issue: out of scope: ottoman tweed brightness, sun lozenges, plaques
calibration.status: unchanged (other owners). The hard sun patches on the q04 bed are still the dominant feature of that view.

issues.issue: The duvet fold still does not read as a fold. The new ridge is a thin bright rod, like a ruled pencil line along the diagonal. The 0.014 triangle shows lit edge faces on its head and aisle legs, so it reads as an outlined label, and under cabin light it has no tonal step (L217 vs the duvet's L218). In omaat_f57 the fold is a soft rounded lip with a shadow on the far side.
issues.fix: Line 309: make the ridge a broad, low, duvet-coloured roll rather than a bright rod: gRBox(0.045, 0.010, 0.42, 0.005, 2) at y 0.533 with duv (#d2cec6), not #dedad3. Line 308: drop the thickness to 0.006 so the leg edges stop catching light, and darken it to #b9b5ad so the step survives cabin light (target triangle/duvet <= 0.92).

issues.issue: The console module still has hard flat triangular wedge ends (a doorstop). In f57, f7 and up_34 the module ends are radiused and blend down into the console top.
issues.evidence: s4 x 520-545, y 270-300 (pixel-identical to w11); v2 x 135-240.
issues.fix: Line 173: extrude 0.46 instead of 0.52, at z -0.68+0.03, and add rounded end blocks at both ends: B.add(gRBox(xs1 - xo - 0.004, y0 - 0.655 + 0.012, 0.03, 0.012, 2), M4.trs((xs1 + xo + 0.004) / 2, (y0 + 0.012 + 0.655) / 2, z), SEATMAT.fConsole) for z = -0.68 - 0.245 and z = -0.68 + 0.215 (adjust to the extrusion span).

issues.issue: The grip slots are square-ish black holes at mid-height of the plinth. In f60, up_34 and f7 they are wide, short rounded recesses (about 2-3:1) high on the plinth box, just under the foot rail, with a lit inner face rather than pure black.
issues.evidence: f60 slot about 70 x 24 px in the upper half of a 60 px plinth; up_34 about 85 x 45 px at the top of the box. Line 264 uses 0.10 x 0.07 at y 0.08 on a 0.15 plinth, SEATMAT.black.

issues.issue: Stipple moire persists on the fluted leaves at grazing and distant angles: the field reads as a dotted mesh instead of ribs.
issues.evidence: qa12a/v5z.png (right unit's leaf), q02 x 840-910 far right leaves.
issues.fix: Line 249: geometry alone cannot fix this. Cheapest option: lower slat proudness from 0.005 to 0.003 (x + 0.0035) to halve the shadow-edge acne. Proper option: replace the slats with one quad with a mip-mapped 0.026-period stripe (atlasUV / LAYER), keeping the line-247 groove backing for near views.

issues.issue: The wood flanks are a touch too dark next to the leaves. Flank/field is v1 39/83 = 0.47, against f60's 39/63 = 0.62 (the right flank in f60 shows its grain clearly; in v1 it is almost black at cabin distance).
issues.evidence: v1 flank L39, field L83; f60 flank L39 (x 940-1170, y 420-760), field L63.
issues.fix: Line 27: fFlank c '#2a221d' -> '#33291f' (about 1.25x). A shared-material change would affect the far LOD (line 353) too, which is fine.

issues.issue: The duvet head end is still a uniform rounded step, where the real cover rolls down and wrinkles.
issues.evidence: q04 x 405, the head edge of the duvet.

issues.issue: There is a 1 px light vertical tick in the forward plinth face with the doors closed.
issues.fix: Probably an edge of the line-202 wardrobe gRBox, or of the line-232 inner leaf face, showing through the plinth face at hx + 0.002. Move the line-262 plinth to hx + 0.003 and check.

issues.issue: Out of scope, noted only: hard sun lozenges dominate the q04 bed; the ottoman tweed is beige where f11 shows charcoal; the plaques.

questions: Is a stripe texture for the leaf field acceptable, to end the grazing-angle moire for good? Geometric slats keep producing stipple at a distance.

Should the turned-down corner be modelled the real way (pad exposed at the corner and the flap mirrored across the fold line onto the duvet), or is the overlay triangle good enough once the rod is removed?
